text: I was with an electric wheelchair everything went well
author: aidarab2025

title: Nice start to our visit to Barcelona
text: Great introduction to Barcelona.  Very friendly staff and a great boat captain who gave us many great suggestions for other landmarks and restaurants to explore in the city.
author: Connector42037969003

title: A tour well worth doing
text: We actually did the 60 minute tour of the Americas Cup bases and it was an excellent tour. Friendly and helpful staff and a terrific audio guide. Highly Ty
author: IanfromRAK

title: A Good Simple Trip
text: Always an excellent short cheap trip. Perfect for the shipping enthusiast as it goes through the dock areas. Freight and cruise liners to be seen and usually busy. Very basic boat but serves the purpose well. No comentary - YES!
author: Howard-Liverpool

title: Great
text: Very good trip for the port visit with a very friendly crew who allowed me to take nice photos.
author: Marco14360

title: Nothing amazing or special
text:
I found nothing interesting... a walk through warehouses, docks and cruise ships.

There is no explanation during the trip....

they said that there is an app that is showing.. but no one teaches anything of this.. saw later on the internet

There is a bar during the tour if you want to buy drinks (including alcoholic beverages) and ice cream, etc.

I took a walk in May, and even with 22 degrees of weather... there's a cold wind coming.

There were people freezing with the wind...

I would not repeat the walk.
author: maiteschneider

title: Relaxing boat ride
text: It’s a nice relaxing boat ride. It would be nicer if they went further along the coast line but it was still enjoyable.
author: Eugenia_S

title: Nice sunset cruise
text: Upon arrival in Barcelona I decided to go for a sunset cruise on the first night of my city trip.  The cruise was for about 40 minutes and was an enjoyable experience.  Also worth its money as the cost was 8 euro.  Onboard you could purchase snacks and drinks.
author: doualagoodhikersjc

title: Nice
text:
We took a cruise at 11:30, the cruise lasted about 45 minutes and its price was around 10 euros per person.

you have an an option to buy water and ice cream on cruise,
the cruise is not guided but you can see all of Barcelona in the distance and the experience is very nice

Tip: There is a discount for students
author: Ilanag31
